notes: Coordinates are tile coords [x,y], origin top-left; approximate - builder may nudge to fit tiles, but must keep warp pairs consistent.
Warp pairing: an exterior 'door'/'warp' and an interior 'warp_in'/'warp' with the same 'link' key form a two-way transfer.
Edge connections: 'span' is the open stretch of this map's edge; 'to_span' the matching stretch on the target map (write map_connections accordingly).
field = default FieldEffects::MAP_FIELDS entry (null = :NONE). segment = badges held when the map first becomes reachable (drives level caps).
detail:'outline' maps (Acts II-V) list only what is fixed so far; full specs follow act by act.
tileset names = files in Graphics/Tilesets of the base project. bgm names = Audio/BGM placeholders.

states: alternate looks of one map keyed by Core story state (act number, choice keys from story/10_CHOICES_ENDINGS.md, ruin_route). Build them as event pages / overlay events on the SAME map unless 'replaced_by' names another map ID. Encounter changes use $PokemonGlobal.encounter_version: 0 default, 1 Bleed-spread (Act IV+), 2 Ruin Route, 3 postgame.
branch_only maps exist only on one story branch; ruin_route maps only on the secret Ruin Route (IDs 960-979).
Outline city exteriors do not list doors yet; links C<id>_PC / C<id>_MART are reserved for them.

id_scheme.100-479: cities: block = 100 + 20*city_index (Ferrow's Landing=0, Briarwick=1 ... Wyrmrest=18); +0 exterior, +1 PC, +2 Mart, +3..+9 interiors, +10..+19 gym
id_scheme.520-899: overworld segments: block = 520 + 20*s (s = badges held, 0-18); +0..+3 routes, +4..+7 dungeons, +8..+9 Bleed zone, +10..+17 interiors/rest houses, +18..+19 optional
